title: Auth — Step-up Approver Redeem (finish) — payload
description: The invited subject, signing as their own DID, names the step-up approver to bind and carries its signed enrolment statement over the ceremony's challenge; the relying party binds the approver and consumes the invite. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

enrollmentId.description: The enrollmentId from auth/step-up/approver/redeem/start, echoed verbatim. Also the `boundTo` of the statement.

approverDid.description: The step-up approver to bind. MUST equal the statement's issuer.

label.description: A name for where the approver lives. Overrides the inviter's suggestion.

statement.description: The approver's complete, signed auth/step-up/approver/attest/0.1 document with `purpose: enrol`, `boundTo` equal to `enrollmentId`, over the start's `challenge` — the proof of possession of the approver key. Verified as received.
